title: Surface Mount Multilayer Ceramic Chip Capacitors (SMD MLCCs) - KC-LINK with KONNEKT Technology (C1105_KONNEKT_KC-Link_C0G, 3/5/2025)
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Values not stated numerically in text/tables are null. volume_cm3 and A_per_uF are derived here (box l*w*h or cylinder pi/4*D^2*L from the stated max dimensions; A_per_uF = I_rms_A / C_uF), not datasheet values. Manufacturer PDF. 650 V parts only. Ripple current is given only as curves ('Typical AC Current Performance 650 V standard / low-loss orientation'); no numeric ripple current or AC-voltage limit and no test condition text -> I_rms fields null. ESR/ESL only as typical upper bounds per configuration (25 C, 100 kHz). (a) = orientation/packaging suffix. Multi-chip L/W/T assignment in the dimension table is ambiguous in text: T values per orientation are copied; L x W = 9.3 x 10.2 mm assumed from the 3640 case for the derived volume only. C0G: no numeric capacitance-vs-DC-bias data. Range 14-880 nF, 500-2000 V, tolerance +-10 % (K), -55 to +150 C.

items.ESR_note: 4-chip: std < 2.5 mOhm, low-loss < 1.1 mOhm typ (25 C, 100 kHz)
